text:
trina: Hey night-owl folks  thinking of doing a Dawn Shift Coffee & Croissant meet-up next Wed at 7:30am in the kitchen nook. Light, casual 95b. Who can make it?

evan: 7:30 works for me, I can swing by after my run. :running_man: 

priya: I'd love that 60a. I can bring butter and jam. Any croissant preferences (plain, almond, chocolate)?

jamie: Plain or almond for me. Also can we have a tiny boardgame corner? Something quick like Sushi Go.

rachel: I'm in 44d. Bringing a French press 375. Do we need to reserve the counter space?

dan: Heads-up, facilities asked that morning events register so we know security pass times. Can someone ping ops?

trina: Good point. @dan can you file the quick room request? Otherwise I'll do it today.

dan: Filed with ops 4e6 ticket #4802. They said fine as long as it's under 15 people and we clean up by 9am.

evan: I'll bring a small electric kettle just in case.

priya: Quick poll: reply with the letter for croissant preference: A) plain B) almond C) chocolate D) vegan/other (note allergy in reply)

jamie: A

rachel: B

evan: A

dan: C

trina: Vegan option noted: @maya (cc not in thread) if you want in we can put out some vegan spreads too.

priya: Also thinking of a tiny sticker-name system so people can mingle with their shift hours. I'll print 20.

jamie: I can bring Sushi Go and a deck of playing cards. Quick 15-min rounds during the last 30 min?

trina: Love it. RSVP so far: trina, evan, priya, jamie, rachel, dan. Thats 6. Ops limit 15 so were good.

eventbot: Reminder scheduled: "Dawn Shift Coffee & Croissant" 95b. 1-day and 30-min reminders will be sent.

evan: Logistics q: can we keep the fridge space free for milk/almond milk? Ill label my thermos.

rachel: I'll add a small label pack and markers.

trina: Awesome. Small request: please bring your own mug if you can to reduce disposables. We'll have a few extras.

priya: Also donating a tiny stash of instant decaf for folks who need it.

jamie: See you Wed sunrise crew 305. Thanks for organizing trina!

trina: Happy to! If anyone else wants to swing by, drop a quick "+1" here and I'll update the print list.
